value_stream.name: Dual Training System (DTS) & TESDA Partnership Program

fields.Participants: Store HR Administrator, Treasury specialist, Bank Officer

workflows.name: DTS Allowance Stipend Calculation Payroll Matching and Disbursement

Controls: - CTL-13: Separate payroll computation from approval; CFO payment approval.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overpayment risk**: Stipends paid to terminated/absent students; mitigated by system validation block checking biometric absence records before invoice release.

steps.activity: Compile approved attendance records and calculate student stipends (typically 75% of minimum wage).
Match stipend calculations with non-employee profiles to confirm active program status.
Generate direct-deposit bank upload file and submit to Treasury.
Approve bank transfer and reconcile stipend disbursement.

fields.Participants: Cost Accountant, Chief Accountant (VS-17.1), HR Compliance Manager

workflows.name: DTS Training Expense Accounting and BIR Deduction Ledgers Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Automated tax-credit expense allocation rules in ERP accounting module.
Controls: - CTL-34: complete tax-compliance controls; Chief Accountant sign-off required.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ineligible expense entry risk**: Mixed ledger accounts trigger BIR tax audit disallowances; mitigated by separate chart of accounts for DTS-eligible expenses.

steps.activity: Compile all monthly DTS program expenses: stipends, school fees, uniforms, materials.
Classify and post eligible training expenses to dedicated DTS tax ledger accounts.
Perform double-entry ledger check ensuring no mixing of standard opex and DTS accounts.
Verify tax deductions tracking matches BIR rules for 50% additional deduction under RA 7686.

fields.Participants: TVI Coordinator, Store Manager, TESDA Regional Officer

workflows.name: Monthly TESDA Compliance Report Compilation and Submission

Automation Opportunity: - Report compilation engine pulling data automatically from LMS and T&A databases.
Controls: - CTL-781: TESDA/DTS compliance controls; HR-L&D Manager approval required.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Agency non-compliance risk**: Late or incomplete reports trigger TESDA program suspension; mitigated by system calendars triggering alerts 7 days before filing deadline.

steps.activity: Aggregate monthly data: active trainees, attendance rates, task log completion, stipends paid.
Draft official TESDA DTS compliance report matching local agency formats.
Secure Store Manager signature and verify documentation accuracy.
Submit compliance packet to TESDA Provincial Office and log receipt.

fields.Participants: TVI Director, Treasury analyst, HR Compliance Specialist

workflows.name: TVI Monthly Administrative Billing and Expense Sharing Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - AP 3-way match system linking school invoice, MOA terms, and student attendance logs.
Controls: - CTL-14: AP match controls; Chief Accountant verification.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double billing risk**: Schools invoice for students already withdrawn or graduated; mitigated by system-matching invoice dates against actual HRIS student status registers.

steps.activity: Receive school administrative fee invoice from TVI partner.
Reconcile invoice charges against active student counts and MOA agreements (W5250).
Approve and post payment request to General Ledger.
Execute bank transfer payment and reconcile vendor ledger.

fields.Participants: External Tax Auditor, Finance Controller (VS-17.4), Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Officer

workflows.name: BIR Certificate of DTS Training Expense Audit

Automation Opportunity: - Direct export file creation for BIR audit package generation.
Controls: - CTL-34: Complete tax compliance controls; CFO approval required on returns.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deduction rejection risk**: BIR disallows DTS deductions due to missing documentation; mitigated by storing all compliance records in secure vault with direct audit access.

steps.activity: Compile annual DTS tax audit package: ledger receipts, MOA agreements, TESDA accreditations.
Audit records against the RA 7686 additional-deduction requirements (50% of DTS system expenses, capped at 5% of direct labor cost) claimed in the annual income tax return.
Submit audited package to BIR during annual income tax return filing.
Track BIR clearance verification and save final assessment certificate.

fields.Participants: Store HR Administrator, Store Manager, HR Compliance Manager

workflows.name: Internal Audit of DTS Program Compliance and Policy Adherence

Automation Opportunity: - Audit scorecard generation tool with automated task assignment features.
Controls: - CTL-781: ensure controlled execution — DTS tax-incentive compliance & reporting; Audit Committee sign-off on findings.
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (internal audit), VS-103 (HR shared services)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Program compliance decay risk**: Stores ignore safety guidelines or under-stipend students, exposing corporate brand; mitigated by mandatory annual audits with corrective action tracking.

steps.activity: Verify store-level compliance with DTS guidelines: biometric logs, safety wear, trainee tasks.
Interview student-trainees regarding supervisor feedback and well-being.
Review stipend payroll payments against attendance matching records.
Generate audit findings report and submit to Audit Committee.

workflows.name: DTS Program Learning and Development Impact Analytics and Cost-Benefit Review

Automation Opportunity: - Automated cost-benefit metrics compiler parsing data from HR and tax databases.
Controls: - CTL-35: budget variance controls; CHRO sign-off on L&D metrics.
Cross-references: - links to VS-103 (HR shared services), VS-19.4 (L&D)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Program viability reporting bias risk**: Low ROI programs continue to consume corporate budgets due to incomplete cost tracking; mitigated by full allocation checks across all cost centers.

steps.activity: Analyze student productivity: category sales, customer survey scores, product accuracy.
Review cost metrics: total allowances paid, uniform costs, training materials, tax savings.
Calculate program ROI (retention benefit vs. program costs).
Present findings and recommendations to CFO.

workflows.name: Annual DTS Tax Savings Computation and Assessment Records

Controls: - CTL-781 (ensure controlled execution — DTS Tax-Incentive Compliance & Reporting (PA-183.3).)
- operational: Tax compliance verification controls; CFO sign-off required.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deduction misallocation risk**: Additional deduction applied to the wrong legal entities; mitigated by reconciling entity-level tax computations before ITR filing.

steps.activity: Compute and document the annual DTS tax-savings schedule (50% additional deduction claimed in the ITR per RA 7686, per legal entity).
Verify deduction allocations matching company entities.
Upload the filed ITR schedules and BIR assessment records to corporate tax records.
Present tax savings metrics report to board audit committee.
